mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_name, SUM(b.amount) AS budget_amount, COALESCE(SUM(x.approved), 0) AS executed_amount, COALESCE(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(x.approved), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(b.amount), 0) * 100, 1), 0) AS rate FROM budget b JOIN dept d ON d.dept_id = b.dept_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT budget_id, SUM(amount) AS approved FROM expense WHERE status = '승인' GROUP BY budget_id) x ON x.budget_id = b.budget_id WHERE b.fiscal_year = #{year} GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name ORDER BY d.dept_id
